Area Net Settlement Service (ANSS)—Allows clients within a defined area to settle qualifying domestic transactions through a central settlement agent bank. changes.old: Clearing Entity—The entity used by the clearing systems to determine processing rules. The clearing entity is always included in the definition of a lowest-level SRE. Network—For Visa and VisaNet, the network is the telecommunications facility used for message switching. For other card program networks (for example, Plus and Interlink), the network dictates the product rules under which a transaction is processed. Every client must participate in the International Settlement Service and can also participate in an NNSS or ANSS to which they qualify.
